svg.aria-label: Echovolve code architecture: the Android edge tier, the in-country pilot tier, the Huawei Cloud demo tier, the data boundary between them, and the shared indicator specification.
svg.title: Echovolve — code architecture
svg.desc: Four zones. Zone one is edge/android, the offline-first teacher phone: capture, ring buffer, log-mel features, MindSpore Lite segmentation and language-ID inference, postprocessing, the Kotlin indicator engine, encrypted storage and a sync outbox. Zone two is the in-country pilot tier on openEuler: FastAPI, jobs, database, dashboard, annotation and model training. Zone three is the Huawei Cloud competition demo, holding synthetic and public data only. Zone four is indicators-core, the single indicator specification with a Python reference, a Kotlin port and golden vectors. An amber band between zones two and three marks the data boundary.
svg.text: Echovolve — code architecture
Three tiers, one indicator specification, and a data boundary drawn by Ethiopian law. Directory names match the proposed monorepo layout.
edge/android/ — the teacher's phone
Kotlin · Jetpack Compose · minSdk 29 · arm64-v8a · fully functional with no network
target: RTF ≤ 0.3 · peak RSS ≤ 300 MB · models ≤ 20 MB

g.text: AudioRecordingCallback catches a call or another app
taking the microphone, and emits MISSING spans
Compose UI · consent screens · local weekly report
Research Mode only — separate written consent, never in Deployment Mode
The lesson's audio is encrypted with a per-lesson AES key, transferred to the in-country research store, and deleted from the phone only after a
verified receipt. It never reaches the cloud tier, and it is excluded from OS backup and device transfer.

svg.text: Deployment Mode writes no raw audio to disk. A span lost to a call, a permission change or a dropped chunk is reported as MISSING — never bridged, smoothed, or counted as silence.
What leaves the phone is one LessonRecord v2 JSON per lesson, kilobytes in size: indicators, versions, capture accounting and quality flags. No audio, no embeddings, no child-level data.
Repository status: edge/android/app is a Compose starter activity. Every other box in this zone is a design target behind gates G0–G2.
Sync is opportunistic, resumable and idempotent. The app is fully usable with no network for days;
a withdrawal takes precedence over anything still sitting in the outbox.
POST /v1/lessons
LessonRecord v2 · idempotent on record_id · per-record result
TLS 1.2+ · certificate pinning · device-bound token
GET /v1/reports/latest
POST /v1/consent
DELETE /v1/teacher/{pseudo_id}
in-country pilot tier — infra/openeuler/
one API, one database, one job runner · openEuler 24.03 LTS SP3 candidate
Proclamation 1321/2024 Art. 22 — personal data stored in Ethiopia

g.text: scope derived server-side from the enrolment,
weekly report from a versioned rule table
withdrawal purge, derived data and backups
same rule table as the offline device report
same code as the demo page
research and training — private network, separate credentials, never exposed on the public API
encrypted audio blobs, Research Mode only,
consent reference required for every row

svg.text: ml/export/ ships seg_student.ms, lid_student.ms and a manifest pinning tensor shapes, class order, feature config, lookahead, quantization scales and hashes. The phone rejects an incompatible bundle atomically.
Repository status: server/, dashboard/, ml/ and infra/ are empty placeholder directories. Nothing in this zone is built, trained, deployed or benchmarked.
DATA BOUNDARY
ADR-003 / ADR-011
separate credentials both sides
cloud → pilot — approved public-corpus data and cloud-trained artefacts may cross, after licence and privacy review
pilot → cloud — no classroom audio, features, posteriors, soft labels, trained weights, logs or identifiers ever cross, in either cohort
Huawei Cloud demo — infra/huawei-cloud/
synthetic and public data only
Region AF-Johannesburg · required by the 2026–27 Innovation Competition, which mandates a Huawei Cloud deployment and a visual demo page.

g.text: audio_mix.py — public speech + MUSAN + RIR + choral
the same server/ and dashboard/ code as the pilot,
plus tools/lesson-simulator as the visual demo page
separate endpoint, credentials, logs and backups
RDS PostgreSQL in the same region and VPC,
GaussDB is an alternative, not a drop-in alias
public corpora and model artefacts, same region
ModelArts does not support encrypted OBS buckets,
so this bucket holds approved public objects only

svg.text: No teacher, school, child or pilot-derived artefact has an entry point into this tier. The demo runs on records that were generated, not collected.
The Regional stage re-runs the submitted code and datasets, and shortlisted entries must be open source — so the generator ships with the repository.
Repository status: infra/huawei-cloud/ is an empty placeholder. No cloud account, region, quota or deployment has been inspected.
one spec, two implementations

g.text: the device port — pure Kotlin, no Android deps
JSON timelines and expected outputs; both
implementations must agree to 1e-6 in CI

svg.text: Compiled into ① · imported by ② · gates every commit.
READING THIS DIAGRAM
solid outline = a proposed module, not built
dashed = consent-gated, or private network only
amber = the boundary Article 22 and ADR-003 draw between personal data and the competition demo
As of 2026-09-27 no product code, build, device benchmark or deployment exists in this repository. Every box is a design target and every budget is a target, not a measurement.
Mirrors docs/research/CODEBASE_STRUCTURE.md and §8 of docs/DIMTS_ARCHITECTURE_CONTEXT.md. Acceptance gates G0–G5 are defined in docs/research/IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW.md.
